master.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Game vehicle Juggernaut: teal heavy-haul prime mover with a multi-axle lowbed, carrying a giant bronze ship propeller standing in a frame secured with chains and appropriate cradles. Equipment: ballast box and oversize-load banners; blank banners if any. Finish: heavy grime and chipped paint. Tires: 1.87 m all-terrain: blocky all-terrain tread with sipes. Exactly 4 near-side road wheels TOTAL for combined truck and lowbed, distribute axle positions between front cab at right and rear lowbed at left; all same size. Load stays attached as one illustration. Premium semi-realistic painted game illustration matching Swamp Scout, readable dark contours, fine mechanical details, rich weathered materials. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Facing RIGHT, cab front face invisible, only side visible. All wheels perfectly circular with centered rims and entirely visible; hub centers horizontal, tire bottoms level, chassis and load horizontal. Soft even daylight. Whole vehicle and load within frame with generous 100 pixel transparent margins on every side, no cropping. Wide canvas at least 1500 pixels long. True transparent background, no ground or cast shadow, no halo, no checkerboard, no text, logos or watermark.
